chunks: When their brother Saleh said to them: 'Will you not take heed?'

key_terms.أَخُوهُمْ: their brother, indicating the close relationship between prophet and people
key_terms.تَتَّقُونَ: you fear (God), from taqwa, meaning to be conscious of God and avoid sin
key_terms.صَالِحٌ: Saleh, the prophet sent to the Thamud

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Saleh say to his people in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the title 'Akhuhum' (their brother) emphasizes Saleh’s genuine kinship with the Thamud, distinguishing him from prophets sent to foreign tribes and underscoring the communal responsibility of the people to heed his warning. This verse serves as a foundational narrative for the concept of divine patience, illustrating how even a prophet with deep social ties could face rejection, thereby validating the eventual punishment of the disbelievers.
